scenes.text: He was admitted complaining that he could not sleep.
Doctors watched him for weeks. He never closed his eyes.
His body was healthy. His mind stayed sharp.
He claimed he had not slept since a fever as a boy.
No one ever found a cause - or a reason to disbelieve him.
Follow Unsolved Archive for the next file.
